Discover Hub71’s Programmes Initiate Initiate is Hub71’s early-stage programme that supports founders at the ideation or pre-MVP stage to turn their ideas into scalable startups.
By joining, founders will be connected with experienced venture builders and gain the resources, mentorship, and ecosystem access needed to transform ideas into startups that can scale.

Apply Now Read More MZN x Hub71 Programme The MZN x Hub71 Programme is a three-month programme powered by Hub71 in partnership with the Khalifa Fund for Enterprise Development, designed to support Emirati founders in transforming innovative ideas into market-ready minimum viable products (MVPs).

Apply Now Read More India The Hub71 Immersion Programme is a structured, in-market experience designed to support international startups as they explore and build connections within Abu Dhabi’s global tech ecosystem.

Delivered in partnership with the UAE–India CEPA Council, the programme provides founders with direct access to key market stakeholders, including investors, corporates and government entities, enabling startups to assess and accelerate their expansion into the region.

Apply Now Read More East Asia 2026 The Hub71 Immersion Programme is a structured, in-market experience designed to support international startups as they explore opportunities to establish and scale in Abu Dhabi.
Connect directly with investors, corporates, regulators and government entities across Abu Dhabi’s global tech ecosystem.
Read More Access Programme Get the support you need to take your business to the next level in Abu Dhabi.
Our Access Program offers a comprehensive support package and a route into the UAE capital’s marketplace.
The benefits include in-kind and cash incentives and access to our vibrant community of capital and corporate partners, and mentors.

Apply Now Read More ECA Anjal Z x Hub71 The ECA Anjal Z x Hub71 programme supports startups addressing challenges across early childhood development, from pregnancy through age eight, by providing direct access to government partners, pilot opportunities, and Hub71’s broader innovation ecosystem.
Apply Now Read More Your gateway to SAVI Hub71 is your startup’s gateway into Abu Dhabi’s SAVI cluster.

Hub71 is Abu Dhabi’s global tech ecosystem, built to empower innovative tech startups to scale from the UAE capital to the world.

Backed by the Abu Dhabi Department of Economic Development and Mubadala Investment Company, we are based in ADGM, where we connect high-growth startups with investors, industry-leading corporations, government partners and enablers, removing friction so founders can grow faster.
By connecting founders with investors, government entities and leading corporates, Hub71 facilitates access to capital, commercial traction and strategic collaborations to support startup growth.
By enabling ambitious teams to tackle challenges across diverse sectors, we are contributing to a more resilient and diversified economy, while positioning Abu Dhabi as a leading global tech hub.
Hub71 is located in Abu Dhabi, United Arab Emirates.
We are based in Abu Dhabi Global Market (ADGM), the fastest-growing International Financial Center in the MENA region.
Our ecosystem connects industry leaders, government entities and investors with a curated pipeline of innovative startups, enabling collaboration and early access to transformative technologies.

Our programmes are designed to equip startups with the tools, expert guidance and market insight to scale while providing streamlined access to capital, market opportunities and Abu Dhabi’s business-friendly regulatory environment.
